name: Dan's Drive-In Grilled Ham & Swiss / Cheddar Sandwich
searchKeywords: dans drive in montpelier grilled cheese
whyItWorks: Lightly griddled white bread with thin-sliced deli ham and melted cheese is lower in fat and smaller in volume than a double drive-in burger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Grilled Ham & Cheese (or plain Grilled Cheese) on white bread, lightly buttered on the griddle.
watchOuts: Blot any excess griddle butter on the bread with a napkin
